target_source_pool: Colorado state and local government job boards

behavior.discovered_results: Stored in Supabase and automatically saved to the Google Sheet
behavior.promotion: All discovered jobs are written automatically to the Google Sheet with the active Track

external_spreadsheet_feeds.name: Games Industry - Remote Job Openings

deduplication.primary: exact application URL and known ATS posting identity
deduplication.secondary: same company/title/location and available description text (review only)
deduplication.same_role_different_location: do not auto-merge unless exact posting identity

external_spreadsheet_feeds.verification: Source spreadsheet may contain stale or geographically restricted openings; verify before active classification.
external_spreadsheet_feeds.live_import_owner: Supabase Edge Function raven-studio-scan, provider remotegamessheet; cron every 15 minutes, source interval 24 hours

game_art_geographic_screening.exclusion: Only an explicit requirement to obtain or hold a work visa or work permit, as established in the listing text.
never_exclude_for: GMT, UTC, CET or other working-hour offsets
Canada, UK, EMEA, Europe or other country/region labels alone
General legal right-to-work language without a mandatory visa/permit
Visa sponsorship not offered, available, or asked as an application question
game_art_geographic_screening.non_geography_controls: Normal remote-versus-onsite, role fit, listing availability and deduplication checks remain independent.
